purpose: The ONE tool identity every SBOM in this run was produced by. Recorded by digest, never by tag: a tag is mutable and cannot identify what enumerated the packages.

invocation.producer_note: The producer is the SHIPPED script, unmodified. Only the syft binary it finds on PATH was replaced, by a shim that execs the digest-pinned container above. Filenames therefore come from sbom_filename() in scripts/lib/common.sh, the same function the consumer calls.
invocation.source_note: syft reads each child straight out of the registry by immutable digest. Nothing was built, nothing was installed, no Dockerfile was executed, and no image was pulled into a local daemon whose image ID would have replaced the manifest digest as the document's subject.

registry.auth: SYFT_REGISTRY_AUTH_* against ghcr.io; read scope only

cohort.derivation: MATRIX_IMAGES x expected_matrix.platforms, from scripts/lib/common.sh — never a literal
